scripts.dev:angular:live: concurrently -k -n stencil,ng-lib,ng-app -c blue,yellow,red "npm run watch:stencil" "npm run watch:angular-lib" "npm run dev:angular"
scripts.dev:react:live: concurrently -k -n stencil,react-lib,react-app -c blue,green,cyan "npm run watch:stencil" "npm run watch:react-lib" "npm run dev:react-app"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n stencil,react,app,watch-sr,watch-ra -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:stencil" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:app" "npm run watch:stencil-to-react" "npm run watch:react-to-app"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=packages/stencil-library && npm run build --workspace=packages/react-library && npm run build --workspace=packages/angular-library
